title: まっすぐは浮かない、ナックルは読めない ― 変化球を力で計算 #Shorts
description:
ボールの速さ・向き・回転から、重力・空気の抵抗・回転の力を1ミリ秒ごとに計算して道すじを解く。フォーシームが「落ちにくい」わけも、ナックルの行き先が読めないわけも、力から見える。ブラウザのアプリ「変化球のしくみ」（技術検証）から。投手の例は架空です。

アプリ: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/pitch-physics/

しし屋 まなびラボ（ほかのアプリ）: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

おもな出どころ: Nathan の軌道計算機、Watts & Sawyer (1975) American Journal of Physics 43、Nathan (2012) Procedia Engineering 34 ほか

音楽: プログラムで合成したオリジナルの音です。

#変化球 #野球 #物理 #まなびラボ

en.title: Fastballs don't rise, knuckleballs can't be read ― pitches computed from forces #Shorts
en.description:
A pitch's path, solved by computing gravity, air drag and the spin force every millisecond from its speed, direction and spin. See why a four-seam fastball "drops less" and why nobody can predict a knuckleball. From "How Pitches Break", a browser app (a tech demo). The pitcher examples are fictional.

App (switch the app to English with the EN button): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/pitch-physics/

Shishiya Manabi Lab (more apps): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

Main sources: Nathan's trajectory calculator, Watts & Sawyer (1975) American Journal of Physics 43, Nathan (2012) Procedia Engineering 34, and others

Music: original sounds synthesized by code.

#Baseball #Physics #Shorts
